# JSON schemas

Each schema's `$id` is the URL it is served at, so an editor or a validator can fetch it from there.

| Schema | Title | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [`audit-v1.json`](/schemas/audit-v1.json) | tfcensus audit backend --format json | The report envelope (report-v1.json) with the backend audit payload. Findings carry identifiers only: bucket names, keys, unit paths, resource addresses and attribute names, never attribute values. |
| [`codify-v1.json`](/schemas/codify-v1.json) | tfcensus codify --format json | The report envelope (report-v1.json) with the import blocks codify wrote, the findings it skipped and the next steps. |
| [`config-v1.json`](/schemas/config-v1.json) | tfcensus configuration | Schema for $XDG\_CONFIG\_HOME/tfcensus/config.yaml and .tfcensus.yaml. Generated from internal/config by `mise run test:golden -- -update`; do not edit. |
| [`drift-v1.json`](/schemas/drift-v1.json) | tfcensus drift --format json | The report envelope (report-v1.json) with the drift payload. Changes carry attribute paths; before and after values appear only with --show-attributes, and sensitive and unknown values are masked even then. notify and report html read this file. |
| [`index-v1.json`](/schemas/index-v1.json) | tfcensus identifier index (inventory --save-index) | The report envelope (report-v1.json) with every managed, current resource instance and its identifiers. It holds no other attribute values. |
| [`inventory-v1.json`](/schemas/inventory-v1.json) | tfcensus inventory --format json | The report envelope (report-v1.json) with the inventory payload. relgap reads terraform\_version and providers\[\].source and version per unit as a pin source. |
| [`move-suggest-v1.json`](/schemas/move-suggest-v1.json) | tfcensus move suggest --format json | The report envelope (report-v1.json) with the moves move suggest found in plans and the drafted migration file. Addresses, types and attribute names are identifiers; no attribute value appears. |
| [`move-v1.json`](/schemas/move-v1.json) | tfcensus move --format json | The report envelope (report-v1.json) with what a move command did to each block and unit of a migration file. Addresses are identifiers; no attribute value appears. |
| [`report-v1.json`](/schemas/report-v1.json) | tfcensus JSON output envelope | Every --format json output is wrapped in this envelope. data is command-specific; its schemas are added per command. |
| [`scan-v1.json`](/schemas/scan-v1.json) | tfcensus scan --format json | The report envelope (report-v1.json) with the scan payload. Findings carry identifiers, tags and state addresses, never state attribute values. codify and report html read this file. |
| [`whois-v1.json`](/schemas/whois-v1.json) | tfcensus whois --format json | The report envelope (report-v1.json) with one answer per query. Answers carry identifiers, tags and state addresses, never state attribute values. |
